items.text: Fixed train tunnel entrances, station connections, and above‑ground ramp linking to prevent void spawns and blocked tracks.
Door controllers no longer become unpaired when a door is re‑skinned.
Recycle Bin now correctly swaps items when dragging onto the workbench upgrade instead of showing an erroneous 'Container does not accept player items!' message.
Added CZ-721 backstory, optional conversations, mission plans, and preserved story access after completion.
Refined extraction mission interactions: hold‑E mission lock, ledger read delay, material consumption after completion, expanded mission card UI, and safe‑pocket item preservation.
Introduced first loot item appearance and removed hotbar outline for it.
Added loot reveal mechanics to extraction missions.
Implemented exterior search behavior for scout drones with 4‑second wind‑up, dodgeable charges, 55‑damage blasts, and mid‑fight strikes.
Added visible light for scout drones, search functionality, and health for nuisance drones.
Prevented raids from starting without a raid map, fixing a crash.
Adjusted loot pricing based on item type, gave furniture its own contents, and set weight for blueprints.
Assigned unique rewards to each enemy type, including monument guards.
Fixed catapult projectiles clipping off‑map.
Corrected third‑person attack alignment to ensure proper hit detection.
Fixed invisible building blocks issue.
Added a new 3 km procedural map scene for extraction raids, populated with more monuments and placed the Outpost on the extraction map.
Marked extraction balloons on the map with a countdown timer and closed them sequentially.
Halved the main inventory size on the extraction map and cleared the map after each raid.
Left the Outpost off the standard raid map and removed the death screen when arriving at the hub.
Introduced scout drones that patrol small monuments and raise alarms when players approach.
Adjusted monument guard tiers: weaker factions now fall under scientists and guards receive loot based on tier.
Increased shop prices, added scrap values to all items, and displayed loot worth to players.
Safe pocket now counts as carried loot, is shown beside looted items, and extracted loot is banked in a stash at raid start.
Prevented players from deploying while crafting, fixing a major exploit.
Fixed a bug where a dying heavy player could drop the client, and corrected turn‑in‑place rotation double‑set causing visual pops.
Added a reload bar next to the weapon in shoulder‑camera view and displayed safe‑pocket info beside looted items.
Prevent monuments from painting grass or forest splat on ocean/oceanside terrain, fixing green patches under water.
Prevent ocean water from appearing inside canyons near the shore by extending mountain topology, fixing water leaks in canyon terrain.
Fixed CH‑47 crate landing on top of powerline pole at the powerplant, ensuring crates drop correctly.
Fixed Nuclear Missile Silo terrain clipping over doorways and underground tunnels, eliminating visual clipping issues.
Added Rail Lift stage to raise buried railway tracks and prevent floating rails at junctions.
Added Rail TerrainFilter to shore ice generation to stop ice spawning over railway tracks.
Updated 14 explosion prefabs to work with new screen shake system.
Fixed ExplosionsOverlay not resetting properly, ensuring overlay clears after explosions.
Corrected ExplosionScreenBounceFade curve sampling direction, fixing bounce fade timing.
Fixed admin UI 'Remove All' popup on vending machines so it can be interacted with.

2026-11-16.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.
Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.
Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.
A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.
Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

2026-11-15.summary:
### Missions & Interactions
- Mission interactions refined: hold‑E actions now lock movement and camera and cancel cleanly; ledger and maintenance‑log reads take 5 seconds and only consume repair materials after completion; safe‑pocket items are preserved when loading before the backpack.

### Drones
- Scout drones now perform exterior searches with a 4‑second wind‑up, fire dodgeable 55‑damage charges, and can strike mid‑fight.

### Raiding
- Starting a raid without a raid map now simply fails instead of causing an error, preventing crashes.

### NPC & AI
- A new apartment‑complex caretaker NPC patrols the building at night, knocks on rented doors and looks through a peephole.

### Loot & UI
- Mission loot is now revealed to players when earned, and the first loot item appears in inventory without hot‑bar outlines for clearer view.

items.text: Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.
Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.
Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.
Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.

2026-11-14.summary:
### Loot & Economy
- Loot now has value‑based pricing, furniture containers have their own specific contents, and blueprints count toward inventory weight.

### Combat & Enemies
- Each enemy type now drops its own unique reward, including monument guards.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Hotbar now shows an action progress bar, indicating how long actions like building or using items will take.
- Console window is now resizable and includes a blurred backdrop, making command input clearer and UI more flexible.
- Error overlay stacking now respects stack‑trace order, ensuring error messages are displayed correctly.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Fixed third-person attack alignment, ensuring attacks now line up correctly with target direction.
